544:t_1:87.en:
$$テッサ$$
($$カナメ$$... Please let me borrow $$相良$$... just for a little while...)

544:t_2:5.en:
$$レナード$$
「The plan has changed. We will go straight to $$ヤムスク１１$$ too.」

544:t_2:6.en:
$$かなめ$$
「Y-you seem pretty lively for someone who nearly died.」

544:t_2:7.en:
$$レナード$$
「Thanks to you. My head's clearer than before.」

544:t_2:8.en:
$$かなめ$$
(That wound on his forehead... It's from when I shot him...)

544:t_2:9.en:
$$レナード$$
「Oh, right. I should give you a greeting to mark my change in policy.」

544:t_2:10.en:
$$かなめ$$
「A change in policy? What are you...」

544:t_2:13.en:
$$レナード$$
「This is my new policy. I'm sick of playing the gentleman with you.」

544:t_2:14.en:
$$レナード$$
「And we don't have much time. From now on, I'll make you obey by force if necessary.」

544:t_2:23.en:
$$宗介$$
($n feels it too... This is my first time here, yet I feel as though I know this place...)

544:t_2:25.en:
$$宗介$$
「Captain, what exactly is this place...」

544:t_2:26.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...As I explained, this was the site of the first $$時空震動$$ experiment in human history, and at the same time...」

544:t_2:27.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The secret of us... the 《$$ウィスパード$$》 lies here.」

544:t_2:29.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm sorry, $l. Please wait a little longer before I explain that.」

544:t_2:30.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But being a $$ウィスパード$$ is also the reason $$アマルガム$$ and other organizations have targeted $$カナメ$$.」

544:t_2:32.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... I also chose you as my guard because of your deep connections to the $$ウィスパード$$, $$相良$$.」

544:t_2:35.en:
$$宗介$$
「I heard about him from $$アル$$. He was the ARX series' chief developer...」

544:t_2:36.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You alone can use the ARX system that $$バニ$$ created...」

544:t_2:37.en:
$$テッサ$$
「You rescued $$ミラ$$, who built the $$レーバテイン$$. You have saved me many times as well. And of course, $$カナメ$$ too.」

544:t_2:38.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I doubt anyone else in the world has such close ties to the $$ウィスパード$$ as you, $$相良$$.」

544:t_2:39.en:
$$宗介$$
(That is true... I have no proof, but if $$ナミ$$ in $$ナムサク$$ was one too, that makes five... Six including $$レナード$$...)

544:t_2:40.en:
$$宗介$$
(Can I dismiss this as coincidence...?)

544:t_2:41.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I don't know if this is coincidence or some kind of fate. But if a god... a supreme being beyond human fate... exists...」

544:t_2:42.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Perhaps you are the savior God sent to rescue us.」

544:t_2:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Your power gives me that strange feeling.」

544:t_2:47.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We should soon be able to see ground zero. Please be careful.」

544:t_2:48.en:
$$テッサ$$
「More than 17 years have passed, so its effects should have weakened, but this place confuses the minds of those who approach it.」

544:t_2:50.en:
$n
「Then this strange feeling we have is also...」

544:t_2:51.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes, it is. I believe the unusual experiment conducted here is probably the cause.」

544:t_2:52.en:
$$テッサ$$
「The residents' minds were contaminated. The deranged residents probably caused terrible tragedies.」

544:t_2:53.en:
$$宗介$$
「A $$時空震動$$ can even cause that?」

544:t_2:54.en:
$$テッサ$$
「To be precise, the problem was the system used to cause that $$時空震動$$.」

544:t_2:55.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ドミトリー・ヴァロフ$$, a genius at the $$人革連$$'s Academy of Sciences...」

544:t_2:56.en:
$$テッサ$$
「He believed the spiritual world spoken of since ancient times could be harnessed scientifically.」

544:t_2:57.en:
$$テッサ$$
「That is the 'all-encompassing realm'... what is called the $$オムニ・スフィア$$.」

544:t_2:59.en:
$$テッサ$$
「It is probably the same kind of thing as the collective unconscious on $$神根島$$.」

544:t_2:60.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I suspect its sharing a name with your $$スフィア$$s, $l, is significant beyond simply meaning 'realm'.」

544:t_2:61.en:
$$宗介$$
「The $$ＴＡＲＯＳ$$ installed in the $$デ・ダナン$$ and $$レーバテイン$$ is, if I recall...」

544:t_2:62.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... It stands for '$$オムニ・スフィア転移反応$$'.」

544:t_2:63.en:
$$宗介$$
「Then perhaps the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$ is also...」

544:t_2:64.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes, it is. It is technology that uses the $$オムニ・スフィア$$.」

544:t_2:65.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Explaining that would take us back to the origins of ASes, and we have no time for that now...」

544:t_2:68.en:
$n
「I hear footsteps approaching... Captain $$テスタロッサ$$, please go on ahead with the others.」

544:t_2:69.en:
$$宗介$$
「You intend to hold them off alone?」

544:t_2:70.en:
$n
「I have $$ジークンドー$$ and $$ブーストアップ$$. And if I have to, I'll call the $$ジェニオン$$.」

544:t_2:71.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I understand. We will leave this to you.」

544:t_2:73.en:
$n
(Don't worry, $$宗介$$. I have no intention of meeting my end in a place like this either.)

544:t_2:74.en:
$n
(The footsteps are louder... Here they come...!)

544:t_2:78.en:
$$クロノ隊員$$
「Advance! We will eliminate anyone who interferes with our mission!」

544:t_2:82.en:
$n
(Why are they so weak...? I can't believe these people had combat training...)

544:t_2:83.en:
$n
(Maybe even when they fight in mobile weapons, they only rely on their machines' performance...)
